judgement.reason: LightRAG supports PostgreSQL storage backends selectable by settings, so moving local file storage to PostgreSQL is a contained change.

reviews.findingEvidence: Durable local filesystem state declared: volume ./data/rag_storage:/app/data/rag_storage (docker-compose.yml lightrag), volume ./data/inputs:/app/data/inputs (docker-compose.yml lightrag), volume ./data/prompts:/app/data/prompts (docker-compose.yml lightrag)
reviews.reason: The shown files only point the working, input and prompt directories at local paths, and no shown setting moves that data to PostgreSQL, Redis or S3, so durable local storage is still needed.
